referenceFunction.generalComment: Production of special components of a ventilation system for an office building with offices, common rooms, kitchen, restaurant, auditorium and car park. Data from call of bid including stainless steel exhaust air hood for commercial kitchen and approximation für decentral fan coil units for conference rooms and offices.
